outcome: Cost-effectiveness of routine setup of intraoperative cell salvage during cesarean delivery

finding: Routine setup of intraoperative cell salvage during cesarean delivery is not cost-effective unless there is a predictably high probability of transfusion (e.g., severe maternal anemia or abnormal placentation) or a reasonable likelihood of massive transfusion.
